text:
Evan K: Hi team — I'm landing my first PR modifying the batcher config in packages/runtime. Tests pass locally but CI linting flagged a couple style rules. Quick clarifying questions about expectations for first-week contributors: are we expected to clean up all lint errors in the same PR or is it ok to leave non-blocking style nits for a follow-up?

Priya S: welcome aboard Evan! For small changes, please fix lint errors in the same PR. If it's a large refactor that touches many files, open a separate PR and link it.

Evan K: got it. The lint errors are two instances of single-quote vs double-quote in a generated proto helper. Can I run the repo autofix?

Lint Bot: autofix available: run `pnpm -w eslint --fix`. Note: autofix will change formatting in multiple files.

Priya S: yes run the autofix, but double-check git diff and keep unrelated formatting changes out of the PR if possible. We try to keep churn minimal.

Evan K: thanks. another small question: what's our preferred branch prefix convention? I see a mix in other repos.

Jared M: for runtime work we generally use `eng/runtime/<short-desc>` or `feat/runtime/<short-desc>`. include ticket if relevant like `ENG-2123-feat/runtime-batcher-timeout`. Keep it kebab-case and under 60 chars.

Evan K: thanks. regarding PR titles and bodies — is there a templated checklist you want in the PR body for reviewers?

Priya S: short checklist is great: 1) what changed, 2) how to test locally (commands + env), 3) perf impact (tokens/s or p99), 4) rollout plan (feature flag), 5) linked tickets. We have a sample in .github/pull_request_template.md but a brief bulleted list is enough.

Evan K: perfect. One more: commit formatting. Should I squash before pushing or rely on squash-and-merge?

Jared M: prefer clean commits during development but we squash-and-merge for single logical changes. If you have multiple logical commits that tell a story (e.g., add tests, then fix bug), leave them and mention in PR why you kept them.

Evan K: noted. CI just posted that the linter is failing on the proto helper because of an eslint rule about quotes. I'll run `pnpm -w eslint --fix` and push.

Lint Bot: CI lint job failed: packages/runtime/src/batcher/proto-helper.ts:18:10 - Unexpected double quotes. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/1918765432/jobs/12

Evan K: pushed autofix. Also added `// TODO: narrow types` comment for a helper that wraps a third-party response — is that acceptable or should I create a follow-up ticket?

Priya S: ok to add `// TODO` with an issue link. Please create the ticket and put the number in the comment so it's traceable.

Evan K: done — created ENG-3456 and added the link in the code comment. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/179. Reviewer: @Priya S

Priya S: will review once CI is green. Quick reminder: add a short migration note only if the change alters runtime behavior. Otherwise put testing notes under "Notes".

Jared M: small tip — if you need a hand with local integration testing for the batcher, ping me and I can share a small harness script we use.

Evan K: appreciate it, will take you up on that if CI flakes. Thanks for the help everyone! :tada:

Lint Bot: CI pipeline started for branch eng/runtime-batcher-timeout (1918765432.000200).
